debug.description: Set to true to enable more verbose output for debugging operation.

gdk_backend.description: Sets the GDK_BACKEND environment variable. Set to 'x11' to fix window position problems on Wayland.

no_cache.description: Set to true to prevent loading from or writing to any source cache files.

no_custom_plugins.description: Set to true to only allow loading built-in plugins installed in the program's python package.

no_keybinder.description: Set to true to disable Keybinder even if it is installed.

no_splash.description: Set to true to launch Kupfer without presenting the main interface.
